description: Postal code lookup (batch) — Look up to 30 postal codes in one call: place, state and coordinates for each, plus the states covered, centroid, bounding box, each code's miles from the centroid and the farthest-apart pair. zips = comma-separated codes. Optional country = ISO-2 code (default US). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: geo_zip_batch
